annotations.text:
Matches the FIFA squad screen's INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE — pitch view, cards with a
position pill beneath, chemistry lines drawn pill-to-pill, club block top-left with a
chemistry bar, player panel right, control legend along the bottom.

The card SILHOUETTE is deliberately ours: chamfered top corners, square base. Not the FUT
shield. That shape and the gold card art are EA's branded assets, and the brief already
settled this — own visual system, rather than relying on tolerance.

Real state from board 003, a Manchester City web.

GIVEN: Kompany, Navas, Álvarez.
FOUND: Fernandinho, Palmer, Eric García.
OPEN: GK, LCB, RB, ST, RW.

Chemistry 33 of a possible 110, against a gate of 100.
LCB is live — and that is where Philippe Sandler sits, fame 23,
the answer almost nobody will reach for.

PLAYER PHOTOS — measured, not guessed. Wikidata P18 links to Wikimedia Commons, and
coverage across our own pool is:  top 500 by fame 100%  ·  mid pool 84%  ·  deep cuts 35%.

Commons images are CC BY / CC BY-SA / public domain, so they are usable with attribution.
Real costs are a credits page and unifying wildly varied crops — not availability.

The gradient is the interesting part: seeded players always have a face, deep cuts often do not.
The silhouettes on the cards here are placeholders, and for a genuinely obscure player the
silhouette may be the honest permanent state. Worth leaning into rather than fixing.
